title: Daily digest: KTR confident of retaining Hyderabad-Ran | BRS leaders stage protest at ED office,  | India has over 80 days fuel reserves: Pu | SC Declines To Intervene In Patan Electi | MLA B. Shivanna appointed KSPCB chairman
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Telangana Today / The Hindu / Deccan Chronicle
bullets_en: KTR confident of retaining Hyderabad-Rangareddy-Mahbubnagar MLC seat.
BRS leaders stage protest at ED office, urge agency to shed silence in case against Ponguleti.
India has over 80 days fuel reserves: Puri.
SC Declines To Intervene In Patan Election Petition.
MLA B. Shivanna appointed KSPCB chairman, says lake, air pollution control among priorities.
bullets_ur: KTR ko Hyderabad-Rangareddy-Mahbubnagar MLC seat barqarar rakhne ka yaqeen.
BRS ke leaders ka ED office par ehtejaj, agency se Ponguleti case mein khamoshi todne ka mutalba.
India ke paas 80 din se zyada fuel reserves hain: Puri.
SC ne Patan election petition mein mudakhlat se inkar kar diya.
MLA B. Shivanna KSPCB chairman muqarrar, kehte hain jheel aur hawa ki aloodgi par control pehli tarjeeh.
